selectedCandidate.whyNarrowestEvidenceBacked: waitForProgress is entered only after the client reached the waypoint. A subsequently validated drift therefore records departure from that reached state. Browser22 @8885 and @9112 are both such fresh client-drift/server-reached samples; recomputing from x selects KeyS even though the existing yaw is within 1.7 or 1.9 degrees of KeyW and about 178 degrees from KeyS. Reversing only this post-drift next key addresses the first proven waste without changing shared aim, mouse safety, generic walk, timeout composition or route tolerances.
